Alif Laam Meem Saad

Yeh kitaab aap ki taraf naazil ki gayi hai, lihaaza aap is ki taraf se kisi tangi ka shikaar na hon, aur is ke zariye logon ko daraayein. Yeh kitaab saahibaan-e-imaan ke liye mukammal yaad-dihaani hai
Logo! Tum us ka ittibaa' karo jo tumhaare Parwardigar ki taraf se naazil hua hai, aur us ke ilaawa doosre sarparaston ka ittibaa' na karo. Tum bahut kam naseehat maante ho
Aur kitne qarye hain jinhein hum ne barbaad kar diya, aur un ke paas hamaara azaab us waqt aaya jab woh raat mein so rahe the ya din mein qailoola kar rahe the
Phir hamaara azaab aane ke baad un ki pukaar sirf yeh thi ke yaqeenan hum log zaalim the
Pas ab hum un logon se bhi sawaal karenge aur un ke rasoolon se bhi sawaal karenge
Phir un se saari daastaan ilm o ittilaa' ke saath bayaan karenge, aur hum khud bhi ghaaib to the nahin
Aaj ke din aamaal ka wazn ek barhaq shai hai, phir jis ke nek aamaal ka palla bhaari hoga wahi log najaat paane waale hain
Aur jin ka palla halka ho gaya yahi woh log the jinhon ne apne nafs ko khasaare mein rakha, ke woh hamaari aayaton par zulm kar rahe the
Yaqeenan hum ne tum ko zameen mein ikhtiyaar diya aur tumhaare liye saamaan-e-zindagi qaraar diye, magar tum bahut kam shukr ada karte ho

Aur hum ne tum sab ko paida kiya, phir tumhaari sooratein muqarrar keen, us ke baad malaaika ko hukm diya ke Aadam ko sajda karein, to sab ne sajda kar liya, sirf Iblees ne inkaar kar diya aur woh sajda karne waalon mein shaamil nahin hua
Irshaad hua ke tujhe kis cheez ne roka tha ke tu ne mere hukm ke baad bhi sajda nahin kiya? Us ne kaha ke main un se behtar hoon, tu ne mujhe aag se paida kiya hai aur inhein khaak se banaaya hai
Farmaaya to yahaan se utar ja, tujhe haq nahin hai ke yahaan ghuroor se kaam le. Nikal ja ke tu zaleel logon mein hai
Us ne kaha ke phir mujhe qiyaamat tak ki mohlat de de
Irshaad hua ke tu mohlat waalon mein se hai
Us ne kaha ke pas jis tarah tu ne mujhe gumraah kiya hai main tere seedhe raaste par baith jaaoonga
Us ke baad saamne, peechhe aur daahine baayein se aaoonga, aur tu aksariyat ko shukr-guzaar na paaega
Farmaaya ke yahaan se nikal ja, tu zaleel aur mardood hai. Ab jo bhi tera ittibaa' karega main tum sab se Jahannam ko bhar doonga
Aur ae Aadam! Tum aur tumhaari zauja donon jannat mein daakhil ho jaao aur jahaan jo chaaho khaao, lekin is darakht ke qareeb na jaana ke zulm karne waalon mein shumaar ho jaaoge

Phir Shaitaan ne un donon mein waswasa paida karaaya ke jin sharm ke maqaamaat ko chhupa rakha hai woh numaayaan ho jaayein, aur kehne laga ke tumhaare Parwardigar ne tumhein is darakht se sirf is liye roka hai ke tum farishte ho jaaoge ya tum hamesha rehne waalon mein se ho jaaoge
Aur donon se qasam khaayi ke main tumhein naseehat karne waalon mein hoon

Phir inhein dhoke ke zariye darakht ki taraf jhuka diya, aur jaise hi un donon ne chakha sharmgaahein khulne lagin, aur unhon ne darakhton ke patte jod kar sharmgaahon ko chhupaana shuroo kar diya. To un ke Rab ne aawaaz di ke kya hum ne tum donon ko is darakht se mana' nahin kiya tha, aur kya hum ne tumhein nahin bataaya tha ke Shaitaan tumhaara khula hua dushman hai
Un donon ne kaha ke Parwardigar! Hum ne apne nafs par zulm kiya hai, ab agar tu maaf na karega aur reham na karega to hum khasaara uthaane waalon mein ho jaayenge
Irshaad hua ke tum sab zameen mein utar jaao aur sab ek doosre ke dushman ho. Zameen mein tumhaare liye ek muddat tak thikaana aur saamaan-e-zindagaani hai
Farmaaya ke wahin tumhein jeena hai aur wahin marna hai, aur phir isi zameen se nikaale jaaoge

Ae aulaad-e-Aadam! Hum ne tumhaare liye libaas naazil kiya hai jis se apni sharmgaahon ka parda karo, aur zeenat ka libaas bhi diya hai, lekin taqwa ka libaas sab se behtar hai. Yeh baat aayaat-e-Ilaahiya mein hai ke shaayad woh log ibrat haasil kar sakein

Ae aulaad-e-Aadam! Khabardaar Shaitaan tumhein bhi na behka de jis tarah tumhaare maa baap ko jannat se nikaal liya, is aalam mein ke un ke libaas alag kara diye taake sharmgaahein zaahir ho jaayein. Woh aur us ke qabeele waale tumhein dekh rahe hain is tarah ke tum inhein nahin dekh rahe ho. Beshak hum ne shayaateen ko be-imaan insaanon ka dost bana diya hai

Aur yeh log jab koi bura kaam karte hain to kehte hain ke hum ne aaba o ajdaad ko isi tareeqe par paaya hai aur Allah ne yahi hukm diya hai. Aap farma dijiye ke Khuda buri baat ka hukm de hi nahin sakta hai. Kya tum Khuda ke khilaaf woh keh rahe ho jo jaante bhi nahin ho

Keh dijiye ke mere Parwardigar ne insaaf ka hukm diya hai, aur tum sab har namaaz ke waqt apna rukh seedha rakha karo aur Khuda ko khaalis deen ke saath pukaaro. Us ne jis tarah tumhaari ibtida ki hai isi tarah tum palat kar bhi jaaoge

Us ne ek giroh ko hidaayat di hai aur ek par gumraahi musallat ho gayi hai, ke unhon ne shayaateen ko apna waali bana liya hai aur Khuda ko nazar-andaaz kar diya hai, aur phir un ka khayaal hai ke woh hidaayat-yaafta bhi hain
Ae aulaad-e-Aadam! Har namaaz ke waqt aur har masjid ke paas zeenat saath rakho, aur khaao piyo magar israaf na karo, ke Khuda israaf karne waalon ko dost nahin rakhta hai

Paighambar! Aap poochhiye ke kis ne us zeenat ko jis ko Khuda ne apne bandon ke liye paida kiya hai, aur paakeeza rizq ko haraam kar diya hai? Aur bataaiye ke yeh cheezein roz-e-qiyaamat sirf un logon ke liye hain jo zindagaani-e-duniya mein imaan laaye hain. Hum isi tarah saahibaan-e-ilm ke liye mufassal aayaat bayaan karte hain

Keh dijiye ke hamaare Parwardigar ne sirf badkaariyon ko haraam kiya hai chaahe woh zaahiri hon ya baatini, aur gunaah aur naahaq zulm aur bila-daleel kisi cheez ko Khuda ka shareek banaane aur bila-jaane-boojhe kisi baat ko Khuda ki taraf mansoob karne ko haraam qaraar diya hai
Har qaum ke liye ek waqt muqarrar hai, jab woh waqt aa jaaega to ek ghadi ke liye na peechhe tal sakta hai aur na aage badh sakta hai

Ae aulaad-e-Aadam! Jab bhi tum mein se hamaare paighambar tumhaare paas aayenge aur hamaari aayaton ko bayaan karenge, to jo bhi taqwa ikhtiyaar karega aur apni islaah kar lega us ke liye na koi khauf hai aur na woh ranjeeda hoga
Aur jin logon ne hamaari aayaat ki takzeeb ki aur akad gaye woh sab Jahannami hain aur usi mein hamesha rehne waale hain

Us se bada zaalim kaun hai jo Khuda par jhoota ilzaam lagaaye ya us ki aayaat ki takzeeb kare? Un logon ko un ki qismat ka likha milta rahega, yahaan tak ke jab hamaare numaainde farishte muddat-e-hayaat poori karne ke liye aayenge to poochhenge ke woh sab kahaan hain jin ko tum Khuda ko chhod kar pukaara karte the? Woh log kahenge ke woh sab to gum ho gaye, aur is tarah apne khilaaf khud bhi gawaahi denge ke woh log kaafir the

Irshaad hoga ke tum se pehle jo jinn o ins ki mujrim jamaa'atein guzar chuki hain tum bhi unhi ke saath Jahannam mein daakhil ho jaao. Haalat yeh hogi ke har daakhil hone waali jamaa'at doosri par la'nat karegi, aur jab sab ikattha ho jaayenge to baad waale pehle waalon ke baare mein kahenge ke Parwardigar! Unhi ne humein gumraah kiya hai, lihaaza un ke azaab ko dugna kar de. Irshaad hoga ke sab ka azaab dugna hai, sirf tumhein maaloom nahin hai
Phir pehle waale baad waalon se kahenge ke tumhein hamaare oopar koi fazeelat nahin hai, lihaaza apne kiye ka azaab chakho

Beshak jin logon ne hamaari aayaton ki takzeeb ki aur ghuroor se kaam liya un ke liye na aasmaan ke darwaaze khole jaayenge aur na woh jannat mein daakhil ho sakenge, jab tak oont sooi ke naake ke andar daakhil na ho jaaye, aur hum isi tarah mujrimeen ko saza diya karte hain
Un ke liye Jahannam hi ka farsh hoga aur un ke oopar usi ka odhna bhi hoga, aur hum isi tarah zaalimon ko un ke aamaal ka badla diya karte hain
Aur jin logon ne imaan ikhtiyaar kiya aur nek aamaal kiye, aur hum kisi nafs ko us ki wus'at se ziyaada takleef nahin dete, wahi log jannati hain aur us mein hamesha rehne waale hain

Aur hum ne un ke seenon se har keene ko alag kar diya. Un ke qadmon mein nahrein jaari hongi, aur woh kahenge ke shukr hai Parwardigar ka ke us ne humein yahaan tak aane ka raasta bata diya, warna us ki hidaayat na hoti to hum yahaan tak aane ka raasta bhi nahin pa sakte the. Beshak hamaare rasool sab deen-e-haq le kar aaye the. To phir inhein aawaaz di jaaegi ke yeh woh jannat hai jis ka tumhein tumhaare aamaal ki bina par waaris banaaya gaya hai

Aur jannati log Jahannamiyon se pukaar kar kahenge ke jo kuch hamaare Parwardigar ne hum se wa'da kiya tha woh hum ne to pa liya, kya tum ne bhi hasb-e-wa'da haasil kar liya hai? Woh kahenge beshak. Phir ek munaadi aawaaz dega ke zaalimeen par Khuda ki la'nat hai
Jo raah-e-Khuda se rokte the aur us mein kaji paida kiya karte the aur aakhirat ke munkir the

Aur un ke darmiyaan parda daal diya jaaega, aur A'raaf par kuch log honge jo sab ko un ki nishaaniyon se pehchaan lenge, aur ashaab-e-jannat ko aawaaz denge ke tum par hamaara salaam. Woh jannat mein daakhil na hue honge lekin us ki khwaahish rakhte honge
Aur phir jab un ki nazar Jahannam waalon ki taraf mud jaaegi to kahenge ke Parwardigar! Hum ko in zaalimeen ke saath na qaraar dena
Aur A'raaf waale un logon ko jinhein woh nishaaniyon se pehchaante honge aawaaz denge ke aaj na tumhaari jamaa'at kaam aayi aur na tumhaara ghuroor kaam aaya

Kya yahi log hain jin ke baare mein tum qasmein khaaya karte the ke inhein rehmat-e-Khuda haasil na hogi? Jin se hum ne keh diya hai ke jaao jannat mein chale jaao, tumhaare liye na koi khauf hai aur na koi huzn

Aur Jahannam waale jannat waalon se pukaar kar kahenge ke zara thanda paani ya Khuda ne jo rizq tumhein diya hai us mein se humein bhi pahunchaao. To woh log jawaab denge ke un cheezon ko Allah ne kaafiron par haraam kar diya hai

Jin logon ne apne deen ko khel tamaasha bana liya tha aur inhein zindagaani-e-duniya ne dhoka de diya tha, to aaj hum inhein isi tarah bhula denge jis tarah unhon ne aaj ke din ki mulaaqaat ko bhula diya tha aur hamaari aayaat ka deeda-o-daanista inkaar kar rahe the
Hum un ke paas aisi kitaab le aaye hain jise ilm o ittilaa' ke saath mufassal bayaan kiya hai, aur woh saahibaan-e-imaan ke liye hidaayat aur rehmat hai

Kya yeh log sirf anjaam-e-kaar ka intizaar kar rahe hain? To jis din anjaam saamne aa jaaega to jo log pehle se use bhoole hue the woh kehne lagenge ke beshak hamaare Parwardigar ke rasool saheeh hi paighaam laaye the, to kya hamaare liye bhi shafee' hain jo hamaari sifaarish karein, ya humein waapas kar diya jaaye to hum jo aamaal karte the us ke ilaawa doosri qism ke aamaal karein? Dar-haqeeqat un logon ne apne ko khasaare mein daal diya hai aur un ki saari iftira-pardaaziyaan ghaaib ho gayi hain

Beshak tumhaara Parwardigar woh hai jis ne aasmaanon aur zameen ko chhe din mein paida kiya hai aur us ke baad Arsh par apna iqtidaar qaaim kiya hai. Woh raat ko din par dhaanp deta hai aur raat tezi se us ke peechhe dauda karti hai, aur aaftaab o maahtaab aur sitaare sab usi ke hukm ke taabe' hain. Usi ke liye khalq bhi hai aur amr bhi. Woh nihaayat hi saahib-e-barkat Allah hai jo aalameen ka paalne waala hai
Tum apne Rab ko gidgida kar aur khaamoshi ke saath pukaaro ke woh ziyaadati karne waalon ko dost nahin rakhta hai
Aur khabardaar zameen mein islaah ke baad fasaad na paida karna, aur Khuda se darte darte aur ummeedwaar ban kar dua karo, ke us ki rehmat saahibaan-e-husn-e-amal se qareeb-tar hai

Woh Khuda woh hai jo hawaaon ko rehmat ki bashaarat bana kar bhejta hai, yahaan tak ke jab hawaayein wazni baadalon ko utha leti hain to hum un ko murda shehron ko zinda karne ke liye le jaate hain aur phir paani barsa dete hain aur us ke zariye mukhtalif phal paida kar dete hain, aur isi tarah hum murdon ko zinda kar diya karte hain ke shaayad tum ibrat o naseehat haasil kar sako

Aur paakeeza zameen ka sabza bhi us ke Parwardigar ke hukm se khoob nikalta hai, aur jo zameen khabees hoti hai us ka sabza bhi kharaab nikalta hai. Hum isi tarah shukr karne waali qaum ke liye apni aayatein ulat palat kar bayaan karte hain

Yaqeenan hum ne Nooh ko un ki qaum ki taraf bheja to unhon ne kaha ke ae qaum waalo! Allah ki ibaadat karo ke us ke ilaawa tumhaara koi khuda nahin hai. Main tumhaare baare mein azaab-e-azeem se darta hoon
To qaum ke ru'asa ne jawaab diya ke hum tum ko khuli hui gumraahi mein dekh rahe hain
Nooh ne kaha ke ae qaum! Mujh mein gumraahi nahin hai balke main Rabb-ul-Aalameen ki taraf se bheja hua numaainda hoon
Main tum tak apne Parwardigar ke paighaamaat pahunchaata hoon aur tumhein naseehat karta hoon, aur Allah ki taraf se woh sab jaanta hoon jo tum nahin jaante ho

Kya tumhein is baat par ta'ajjub hai ke tumhaare Parwardigar ki taraf se tum hi mein se ek mard par zikr naazil ho jaaye ke woh tumhein daraaye aur tum muttaqi ban jaao, aur shaayad is tarah qaabil-e-reham bhi ho jaao

Phir un logon ne Nooh ki takzeeb ki to hum ne inhein aur un ke saathiyon ko kashti mein najaat de di, aur jin logon ne hamaari aayaton ko jhutlaaya tha inhein gharq kar diya, ke woh sab bilkul andhe log the
Aur hum ne qaum-e-Aad ki taraf un ke bhaai Hood ko bheja to unhon ne kaha ke ae qaum waalo! Allah ki ibaadat karo, us ke ilaawa tumhaara doosra khuda nahin hai. Kya tum darte nahin ho
Qaum mein se kufr ikhtiyaar karne waale ru'asa ne kaha ke hum tum ko hamaaqat mein mubtala dekh rahe hain, aur hamaare khayaal mein tum jhooton mein se ho
Unhon ne jawaab diya ke mujh mein hamaaqat nahin hai balke main Rabb-ul-Aalameen ki taraf se firistaada rasool hoon
Main tum tak apne Rab ke paighaamaat pahunchaata hoon aur tumhaare liye ek amaanatdaar naaseh hoon

Kya tum logon ko is baat par ta'ajjub hai ke tum tak zikr-e-Khuda tumhaare hi kisi aadmi ke zariye aa jaaye taake woh tumhein daraaye? Aur yaad karo ke tum ko us ne qaum-e-Nooh ke baad zameen mein jaanasheen banaaya hai aur makhlooqaat mein wus'at ata ki hai. Lihaaza tum Allah ki ne'maton ko yaad karo ke shaayad isi tarah falaah aur najaat pa jaao

Un logon ne kaha ke kya aap yeh paighaam laaye hain ke hum sirf ek Khuda ki ibaadat karein aur jin ki hamaare aaba o ajdaad ibaadat karte the un sab ko chhod dein? To aap apne wa'da o waeed ko le kar aaiye agar apni baat mein sachche hain

Unhon ne jawaab diya ke tumhaare oopar Parwardigar ki taraf se azaab aur ghazab tai ho chuka hai. Kya tum mujh se un naamon ke baare mein jhagda karte ho jo tum ne aur tumhaare buzurgon ne khud tai kar liye hain aur Khuda ne un ke baare mein koi burhaan naazil nahin kiya hai? To ab tum azaab ka intizaar karo, main bhi tumhaare saath intizaar karne waalon mein hoon
Phir hum ne inhein aur un ke saathiyon ko apni rehmat se najaat de di, aur apni aayaat ki takzeeb karne waalon ki nasl munqata' kar di, aur woh log hargiz saahibaan-e-imaan nahin the

Aur hum ne qaum-e-Samood ki taraf un ke bhaai Saaleh ko bheja to unhon ne kaha ke ae qaum waalo! Allah ki ibaadat karo ke us ke ilaawa koi khuda nahin hai. Tumhaare paas Parwardigar ki taraf se daleel aa chuki hai. Yeh Khudaai naaqa hai jo tumhaare liye us ki nishaani hai. Ise aazaad chhod do ke zameen-e-Khuda mein khaata phire, aur khabardaar ise koi takleef na pahunchaana ke tum ko azaab-e-aleem apni giraft mein le le

Us waqt ko yaad karo jab us ne tum ko qaum-e-Aad ke baad jaanasheen banaaya aur zameen mein is tarah basaaya ke tum hamwaar zameenon mein qasr banaate the aur pahaadon ko kaat kaat kar ghar banaate the. To ab Allah ki ne'maton ko yaad karo aur zameen mein fasaad na phailaate phiro

To un ki qaum ke bade logon ne kamzor bana diye jaane waale logon mein se jo imaan laaye the un se kehna shuroo kiya ke kya tumhein is ka yaqeen hai ke Saaleh Khuda ki taraf se bheje gaye hain? Unhon ne kaha ke beshak humein un ke paighaam ka imaan aur eeqaan haasil hai
To bade logon ne jawaab diya ke hum to un baaton ke munkir hain jin par tum imaan laane waale ho
Phir yeh keh kar naaqe ke paaon kaat diye aur hukm-e-Khuda se sartaabi ki, aur kaha ke Saaleh! Agar tum Khuda ke rasool ho to jis azaab ki dhamki de rahe the use le aao
To inhein zalzale ne apni giraft mein le liya ke apne ghar hi mein sar-ba-zaanoo reh gaye
To us ke baad Saaleh ne un se munh pher liya aur kaha ke ae qaum! Main ne Khudaai paighaam ko pahunchaaya, tum ko naseehat ki, magar afsos ke tum naseehat karne waalon ko dost nahin rakhte ho
Aur Loot ko yaad karo ke jab unhon ne apni qaum se kaha ke tum woh badkaari karte ho jis ki to tum se pehle aalameen mein koi misaal nahin hai
Tum az-raah-e-shahwat auraton ke bajaaye mardon se ta'alluqaat paida karte ho, aur tum yaqeenan israaf aur ziyaadati karne waale ho
Aur un ki qaum ke paas koi jawaab na tha siwaaye is ke ke unhon ne logon ko ubhaara ke inhein apne qarye se nikaal baahar karo ke yeh bahut paak-baaz bante hain
To hum ne inhein aur un ke tamaam ahl ko najaat de di un ki zauja ke ilaawa, ke woh peechhe reh jaane waalon mein se thi
Hum ne un ke oopar khaas qism ke (pattharon) ki baarish ki, to ab dekho ke mujrimeen ka anjaam kaisa hota hai

Aur hum ne qaum-e-Madyan ki taraf un ke bhaai Shu'aib ko bheja to unhon ne kaha ke Allah ki ibaadat karo ke us ke ilaawa koi khuda nahin hai. Tumhaare paas Parwardigar ki taraf se daleel aa chuki hai. Ab naap tol ko poora poora rakho aur logon ko cheezein kam na do, aur islaah ke baad zameen mein fasaad barpa na karo. Yahi tumhaare haq mein behtar hai agar tum imaan laane waale ho

Aur khabardaar har raaste par baith kar imaan waalon ko daraane dhamkaane aur raah-e-Khuda se rokne ka kaam chhod do, ke tum us mein bhi kaji talaash kar rahe ho, aur yeh yaad karo ke tum bahut kam the, Khuda ne kasrat ata ki, aur yeh dekho ke fasaad karne waalon ka anjaam kya hota hai

Aur agar tum mein se ek jamaa'at mere laaye hue paighaam par imaan le aayi aur ek imaan nahin laayi to thehro yahaan tak ke Khuda hamaare darmiyaan apna faisla saadir kar de, ke woh behtareen faisla karne waala hai

Un ki qaum ke mustakbireen ne kaha ke ae Shu'aib! Hum tum ko aur tumhaare saath imaan laane waalon ko apni basti se nikaal baahar karenge, ya tum bhi palat kar hamaare mazhab par aa jaao. Unhon ne jawaab diya ke chaahe hum tumhaare mazhab se bezaar hi kyon na hon

Yeh Allah par bada bohtaan hoga agar hum tumhaare mazhab par aa jaayein jab ke us ne hum ko is mazhab se najaat de di hai, aur humein haq nahin hai ke hum tumhaare mazhab par aa jaayein jab tak Khuda khud na chaahe. Hamaare Parwardigar ka ilm har shai par haawi hai aur hamaara e'temaad usi ke oopar hai. Khudaya! Tu hamaare aur hamaari qaum ke darmiyaan haq se faisla farma de ke tu behtareen faisla karne waala hai
To un ki qaum ke kuffaar ne kaha ke agar tum log Shu'aib ka ittibaa' kar loge to tumhaara shumaar khasaare waalon mein ho jaaega
Nateeja yeh hua ke inhein zalzale ne apni giraft mein le liya aur apne ghar mein sar-ba-zaanoo ho gaye
Jin logon ne Shu'aib ki takzeeb ki woh aise barbaad hue goya us basti mein base hi nahin the. Jin logon ne Shu'aib ko jhutlaaya wahi khasaare waale qaraar paaye

Us ke baad Shu'aib ne un se munh pher liya aur kaha ke ae qaum! Main ne apne Parwardigar ke paighaamaat ko pahuncha diya aur tumhein naseehat bhi ki, to ab kufr ikhtiyaar karne waalon ke haal par kis tarah afsos karoon
Aur hum ne jab bhi kisi qarye mein koi nabi bheja to ahl-e-qarya ko naafarmaani par sakhti aur pareshaani mein zaroor mubtala kiya ke shaayad woh log hamaari baargaah mein tazarru' o zaari karein

Phir hum ne buraai ki jagah achchhaai de di yahaan tak ke woh log badh nikle aur kehne lage ke yeh takleef o raahat to hamaare buzurgon tak bhi aa chuki hai, to hum ne achaanak inhein apni giraft mein le liya aur inhein is ka sha'oor bhi na ho saka

Aur agar ahl-e-qarya imaan le aate aur taqwa ikhtiyaar kar lete to hum un ke liye zameen aur aasmaan se barkaton ke darwaaze khol dete, lekin unhon ne takzeeb ki to hum ne un ko un ke aamaal ki giraft mein le liya
Kya ahl-e-qarya is baat se maamoon hain ke yeh sote hi rahein aur hamaara azaab raaton raat naazil ho jaaye
Ya is baat se mutma'in hain ke yeh khel kood mein masroof rahein aur hamaara azaab din dahaade naazil ho jaaye
Kya yeh log Khudaai tadbeer ki taraf se mutma'in ho gaye hain, jab ke aisa itminaan sirf ghaate mein rehne waalon ko hota hai

Kya ek qaum ke baad doosre zameen ke waaris hone waalon ko yeh hidaayat nahin milti ke agar hum chaahte to un ke gunaahon ki bina par inhein bhi mubtala-e-museebat kar dete aur un ke dilon par mohr laga dete aur phir inhein kuch sunaai na deta

Yeh woh bastiyaan hain jin ki khabrein hum aap se bayaan kar rahe hain, ke hamaare paighambar un ke paas mo'jizaat le kar aaye magar pehle se takzeeb karne ki bina par yeh imaan na la sake. Hum isi tarah kaafiron ke dilon par mohr laga diya karte hain
Hum ne un ki aksariyat mein ahd o paimaan ki paasdaari nahin paayi, aur un ki aksariyat ko faasiq aur hudood-e-itaa'at se khaarij hi paaya
Phir un sab ke baad hum ne Moosa ko apni nishaaniyaan de kar Fir'aun aur us ki qaum ki taraf bheja, to un logon ne bhi zulm kiya, to ab dekho ke fasaad karne waalon ka anjaam kya hota hai
Aur Moosa ne Fir'aun se kaha ke main Rabb-ul-Aalameen ki taraf se firistaada paighambar hoon
Mere liye laazim hai ke main Khuda ke baare mein haq ke ilaawa kuch na kahoon. Main tere paas tere Rab ki taraf se mo'jiza le kar aaya hoon, lihaaza Bani Israaeel ko mere saath bhej de
Us ne kaha ke agar tum mo'jiza laaye ho aur apni baat mein sachche ho to woh mo'jiza pesh karo
Moosa ne apna asa phenk diya aur woh achchha khaasa saanp ban gaya
Aur phir apne haath ko nikaala to woh dekhne waalon ke liye intihaai raushan aur chamakdaar tha
Fir'aun ki qaum ke ru'asa ne kaha ke yeh to samajhdaar jaadugar hai
Jo tum logon ko tumhaari sarzameen se nikaalna chaahta hai, ab tum logon ka kya khayaal hai
Logon ne kaha ke un ko aur un ke bhaai ko rok lijiye aur mukhtalif shehron mein jama karne waalon ko bhejiye
Jo tamaam maahir jaadugaron ko bula kar le aayein
Jaadugar Fir'aun ke paas haazir ho gaye aur unhon ne kaha ke agar hum ghaalib aa gaye to kya humein is ki ujrat milegi
Fir'aun ne kaha beshak, tum mere darbaar mein muqarrab ho jaaoge
Un logon ne kaha ke Moosa! Aap asa phenkenge ya hum apne kaam ka aaghaaz karein
Moosa ne kaha ke tum ibtida karo. Un logon ne rassiyaan phenkeen to logon ki aankhon par jaadu kar diya aur inhein khaufzada kar diya aur bahut bade jaadu ka muzaahira kiya
Aur hum ne Moosa ko ishaara kiya ke ab tum bhi apna asa daal do, woh un ke tamaam jaadu ke saanpon ko nigal jaaega
Nateeja yeh hua ke haq saabit ho gaya aur un ka kaarobaar baatil ho gaya
Woh sab maghloob ho gaye aur zaleel ho kar waapas ho gaye
Aur jaadugar sab ke sab sajde mein gir pade
Un logon ne kaha ke hum aalameen ke Parwardigar par imaan le aaye
Ya'ni Moosa aur Haaroon ke Rab par

Fir'aun ne kaha ke tum meri ijaazat se pehle kaise imaan le aaye? Yeh tumhaara makr hai jo tum shehar mein phaila rahe ho taake logon ko shehar se baahar nikaal sako, to anqareeb tumhein is ka anjaam maaloom ho jaaega
Main tumhaare haath aur paaon mukhtalif samton se kaat doonga aur us ke baad tum sab ko sooli par latka doonga
Un logon ne jawaab diya ke hum log bahar-haal apne Parwardigar ki baargaah mein palat kar jaane waale hain
Aur tu hum se sirf is baat par naaraaz hai ke hum apne Rab ki nishaaniyon par imaan le aaye hain. Khudaya! Hum par sabr ki baarish farma aur humein Musalmaan duniya se uthaana

Aur Fir'aun ki qaum ke ek giroh ne kaha ke kya tu Moosa aur un ki qaum ko yunhi chhod dega ke yeh zameen mein fasaad barpa karein aur tujhe aur tere khudaaon ko chhod dein? Us ne kaha ke main anqareeb un ke ladkon ko qatl kar daaloonga aur un ki auraton ko zinda rakhoonga, main un par quwwat aur ghalaba rakhta hoon

Moosa ne apni qaum se kaha ke Allah se madad maango aur sabr karo. Zameen Allah ki hai, woh apne bandon mein jis ko chaahta hai waaris banaata hai, aur anjaam-e-kaar bahar-haal saahibaan-e-taqwa ke liye hai

Qaum ne kaha ke hum tumhaare aane se pehle bhi sataaye gaye aur tumhaare aane ke baad bhi sataaye gaye. Moosa ne jawaab diya ke anqareeb tumhaara Parwardigar tumhaare dushman ko halaak kar dega aur tumhein zameen mein us ka jaanasheen bana dega, aur phir dekhega tumhaara tarz-e-amal kaisa hota hai
Aur hum ne Aal-e-Fir'aun ko qahat aur samaraat ki kami ki giraft mein le liya ke shaayad woh isi tarah naseehat haasil kar sakein

Us ke baad jab un ke paas koi neki aayi to unhon ne kaha ke yeh to hamaara haq hai, aur jab buraai aayi to kehne lage ke yeh Moosa aur un ke saathiyon ka asar hai. Aagaah ho jaao ke un ki bad-shuguni ke asbaab Khuda ke yahaan maaloom hain, lekin un ki aksariyat is raaz se bekhabar hai
Aur qaum waalon ne kaha ke Moosa! Tum kitni hi nishaaniyaan jaadu karne ke liye laao, hum tum par imaan laane waale nahin hain
Phir hum ne un par toofaan, tiddi, joon, maindak aur khoon ko mufassal nishaani bana kar bheja, lekin un logon ne istikbaar aur inkaar se kaam liya, aur yeh log waaqe'an mujrim log the

Aur jab un par azaab naazil ho gaya to kehne lage ke Moosa! Apne Rab se dua karo jis baat ka us ne wa'da kiya hai. Agar tum ne is azaab ko door kara diya to hum tum par imaan bhi laayenge aur Bani Israaeel ko tumhaare hawaale bhi kar denge
Us ke baad jab hum ne ek muddat ke liye azaab ko bar-taraf kar diya to phir apne ahd ko todne waalon mein shaamil ho gaye
Phir hum ne un se intiqaam liya aur inhein darya mein gharq kar diya, ke unhon ne hamaari aayaat ko jhutlaaya tha aur un ki taraf se ghaflat baratne waale the

Aur hum ne mustaz'afeen ko sharq o gharb-e-zameen ka waaris bana diya aur us mein barkat ata kar di, aur is tarah Bani Israaeel par Allah ki behtareen baat tamaam ho gayi ke unhon ne sabr kiya tha, aur jo kuch Fir'aun aur us ki qaum waale bana rahe the hum ne sab ko barbaad kar diya aur un ki oonchi oonchi imaaraton ko mismaar kar diya

Aur hum ne Bani Israaeel ko darya paar pahuncha diya to woh ek aisi qaum ke paas pahunche jo apne buton ke gird majma' lagaaye baithi thi. Un logon ne Moosa se kaha ke Moosa! Hamaare liye bhi aisa hi khuda bana do jaisa ke un ka khuda hai. Unhon ne kaha ke tum log bilkul jaahil ho
Un logon ka nizaam barbaad hone waala aur un ke aamaal baatil hain
Kya main Khuda ke ilaawa tumhaare liye doosra khuda talaash karoon jab ke us ne tumhein aalameen par fazeelat di hai

Aur jab hum ne tum ko Fir'aun waalon se najaat di jo tumhein badtareen azaab mein mubtala kar rahe the, tumhaare ladkon ko qatl kar rahe the aur ladkiyon ko khidmat ke liye baaqi rakh rahe the, aur is mein tumhaare liye Parwardigar ki taraf se sakht-tareen imtehaan tha

Aur hum ne Moosa se tees raaton ka wa'da liya aur use das mazeed raaton se mukammal kar diya, ke is tarah un ke Rab ka wa'da chaalees raaton ka wa'da ho gaya. Aur unhon ne apne bhaai Haaroon se kaha ke tum qaum mein meri niyaabat karo aur islaah karte raho, aur khabardaar mufsidon ke raaste ka ittibaa' na karna

To us ke baad jab Moosa hamaara wa'da poora karne ke liye aaye aur un ke Rab ne un se kalaam kiya to unhon ne kaha ke Parwardigar! Mujhe apna jalwa dikha de. Irshaad hua tum hargiz mujhe nahin dekh sakte ho, albatta pahaad ki taraf dekho, agar yeh apni jagah par qaaim reh gaya to phir mujhe dekh sakte ho. Us ke baad jab pahaad par Parwardigar ki tajalli hui to pahaad choor choor ho gaya aur Moosa behosh ho kar gir pade. Phir jab inhein hosh aaya to kehne lage ke Parwardigar! Tu paak o paakeeza hai, main teri baargaah mein tauba karta hoon aur main sab se pehla imaan laane waala hoon
Irshaad hua ke Moosa! Hum ne tamaam insaanon mein apni risaalat aur apne kalaam ke liye tumhaara intikhaab kiya hai, lihaaza ab is kitaab ko le lo aur Allah ke shukr-guzaar bandon mein ho jaao

Aur hum ne Taurait ki takhtiyon mein har shai mein se naseehat ka hissa aur har cheez ki tafseel likh di hai, lihaaza ise mazbooti ke saath pakad lo aur apni qaum ko hukm do ke is ki achchhi achchhi baaton ko le lein. Main anqareeb tumhein faasiqeen ke ghar dikhla doonga

Main anqareeb apni aayaton ki taraf se un logon ko pher doonga jo roo-e-zameen mein naahaq akadte phirte hain, aur yeh kisi bhi nishaani ko dekh lein imaan laane waale nahin hain. Un ka haal yeh hai ke hidaayat ka raasta dekhenge to use apna raasta na banaayenge, aur gumraahi ka raasta dekhenge to use fauran ikhtiyaar kar lenge. Yeh sab is liye hai ke unhon ne hamaari nishaaniyon ko jhutlaaya hai aur un ki taraf se ghaafil the
Aur jin logon ne hamaari nishaaniyon aur aakhirat ki mulaaqaat ko jhutlaaya hai un ke aamaal barbaad hain, aur zaahir hai ke inhein waisa hi badla to diya jaaega jaise aamaal kar rahe hain

Aur Moosa ki qaum ne un ke baad apne zewaraat se gosaale ka mujassama banaaya jis mein aawaaz bhi thi. Kya un logon ne nahin dekha ke woh na baat karne ke laaiq hai aur na koi raasta dikha sakta hai? Unhon ne use khuda bana liya aur woh log waaqe'an zulm karne waale the

Aur jab woh pachhtaaye aur unhon ne dekh liya ke woh behak gaye hain to kehne lage ke agar hamaara Parwardigar hamaare oopar reham na karega aur humein maaf na karega to hum khasaare waalon mein shaamil ho jaayenge

Aur jab Moosa apni qaum ki taraf waapas aaye to ghaiz o ghazab ke aalam mein kehne lage ke tum ne mere baad bahut buri harkat ki hai. Tum ne hukm-e-Khuda ke aane mein kis qadr ujlat se kaam liya hai. Aur phir unhon ne Taurait ki takhtiyon ko daal diya aur apne bhaai ka sar pakad kar kheenchne lage. Haaroon ne kaha bhaai! Qaum ne mujhe kamzor bana diya tha aur qareeb tha ke mujhe qatl kar dete, to main kya karta? Aap dushmanon ko ta'ne ka mauqa na dijiye aur mera shumaar zaalimeen ke saath na kijiye
Moosa ne kaha ke Parwardigar! Mujhe aur mere bhaai ko maaf kar de aur humein apni rehmat mein daakhil kar le ke tu sab se ziyaada reham karne waala hai

Beshak jin logon ne gosaale ko ikhtiyaar kiya hai anqareeb un par ghazab-e-Parwardigar naazil hoga, aur un ke liye zindagaani-e-duniya mein bhi zillat hai, aur hum isi tarah iftira karne waalon ko saza diya karte hain
Aur jin logon ne bure aamaal kiye aur phir tauba kar li aur imaan le aaye, to tauba ke baad tumhaara Parwardigar bahut bakhshne waala bada meharbaan hai
Us ke baad jab Moosa ka ghussa thanda pad gaya to unhon ne takhtiyon ko utha liya, aur us ke nuskhe mein hidaayat aur rehmat ki baatein thin un logon ke liye jo apne Parwardigar se darne waale the

Aur Moosa ne hamaare wa'de ke liye apni qaum ke sattar afraad ka intikhaab kiya. Phir us ke baad jab ek jhatke ne inhein apni lapet mein le liya to kehne lage ke Parwardigar! Agar tu chaahta to inhein pehle hi halaak kar deta aur mujhe bhi. Kya ab ahmaqon ki harkat ki bina par humein bhi halaak kar dega? Yeh to sirf tera imtehaan hai jis se jis ko chaahta hai gumraahi mein chhod deta hai aur jis ko chaahta hai hidaayat de deta hai. Tu hamaara waali hai, humein maaf kar de aur hum par reham farma ke tu bada bakhshne waala hai

Aur hamaare liye is daar-e-duniya aur aakhirat mein neki likh de, hum teri hi taraf rujoo' kar rahe hain. Irshaad hua ke mera azaab jise main chaahoonga us tak pahunchega aur meri rehmat har shai par wasee' hai, jise main anqareeb un logon ke liye likh doonga jo khauf-e-Khuda rakhne waale, zakaat ada karne waale aur hamaari nishaaniyon par imaan laane waale hain

Jo log ke Rasool-e-Nabi-e-Ummi ka ittibaa' karte hain jis ka zikr apne paas Taurait aur Injeel mein likha hua paate hain, ke woh nekiyon ka hukm deta hai aur buraaiyon se rokta hai, aur paakeeza cheezon ko halaal qaraar deta hai aur khabees cheezon ko haraam qaraar deta hai, aur un par se ahkaam ke sangeen bojh aur qaid o band ko utha deta hai. Pas jo log us par imaan laaye, us ka ehteraam kiya, us ki imdaad ki aur us noor ka ittibaa' kiya jo us ke saath naazil hua hai, wahi dar-haqeeqat falaah-yaafta aur kaamyaab hain

Paighambar! Keh do ke main tum sab ki taraf us Allah ka rasool aur numaainda hoon jis ke liye zameen o aasmaan ki mamlakat hai. Us ke ilaawa koi khuda nahin hai, wahi hayaat deta hai aur wahi maut deta hai. Lihaaza Allah aur us ke Paighambar-e-Ummi par imaan le aao jo Allah aur us ke kalimaat par imaan rakhta hai, aur usi ka ittibaa' karo ke shaayad isi tarah hidaayat-yaafta ho jaao
Aur Moosa ki qaum mein se ek aisi jamaa'at bhi hai jo haq ke saath hidaayat karti hai aur mu'aamalaat mein haq o insaaf ke saath kaam karti hai

Aur hum ne Bani Israaeel ko Ya'qoob ki baarah aulaad ke baarah hisson par taqseem kar diya, aur Moosa ki taraf wahi ki jab un ki qaum ne paani ka mutaalaba kiya ke zameen par asa maar do. Unhon ne asa maara to baarah chashme jaari ho gaye, is tarah ke har giroh ne apne ghaat ko pehchaan liya. Aur hum ne un ke saron par abr ka saaya kiya aur un par Mann o Salwa jaisi ne'mat naazil ki ke hamaare diye hue paakeeza rizq ko khaao. Aur un logon ne mukhaalifat kar ke hamaare oopar zulm nahin kiya balke yeh apne hi nafs par zulm kar rahe the

Aur us waqt ko yaad karo jab un se kaha gaya ke is qarye mein daakhil ho jaao aur jo chaaho khaao, lekin Hittah keh kar daakhil hona aur daakhil hote waqt sajda karte hue daakhil hona taake hum tumhaari khataaon ko maaf kar dein, ke hum anqareeb nek amal waalon ke ajr mein izaafa bhi kar denge
Lekin zaalimon ne jo inhein bataaya gaya tha us ko badal kar kuch aur kehna shuroo kar diya, to hum ne un ke oopar aasmaan se azaab naazil kar diya ke yeh fisq aur naafarmaani kar rahe the

Aur un se us qarye ke baare mein poochho jo samandar ke kinaare tha aur jis ke baashinde Shamba ke baare mein ziyaadati se kaam lete the, ke un ki machhliyaan Shamba ke din sath-e-aab tak aa jaati thin aur doosre din nahin aati thin, to unhon ne heela-gari karna shuroo kar di. Hum isi tarah un ka imtehaan lete the ke yeh log fisq aur naafarmaani se kaam le rahe the

Aur jab un ki ek jamaa'at ne muslihoon se kaha ke tum kyon aisi qaum ko naseehat karte ho jise Allah halaak karne waala hai ya us par shadeed azaab karne waala hai? To unhon ne kaha ke hum Parwardigar ki baargaah mein uzr chaahte hain, aur shaayad yeh log muttaqi ban hi jaayein

Us ke baad jab unhon ne yaad-dihaani ko faraamosh kar diya to hum ne buraaiyon se rokne waalon ko bacha liya aur zaalimon ko un ke fisq aur bad-kirdaari ki bina par sakht-tareen azaab ki giraft mein le liya
Phir jab dobaara mumaana'at ke ba-wujood sarkashi ki to hum ne hukm de diya ke ab zillat ke saath bandar ban jaao

Aur us waqt ko yaad karo jab tumhaare Parwardigar ne ala-l-e'laan keh diya ke qiyaamat tak un par aise afraad musallat kiye jaayenge jo inhein badtareen sakhtiyon mein mubtala karenge, ke tumhaara Parwardigar jaldi azaab karne waala bhi hai aur bahut ziyaada bakhshne waala meharbaan bhi hai

Aur hum ne Bani Israaeel ko mukhtalif tukdon mein taqseem kar diya, ba'z nek-kirdaar the aur ba'z us ke khilaaf, aur hum ne inhein aaraam aur sakhti ke zariye aazmaaya ke shaayad raaste par aa jaayein

Us ke baad un mein ek nasl paida hui jo kitaab ki waaris to bani lekin duniya ka har maal leti rahi aur yeh kehti rahi ke anqareeb humein bakhsh diya jaaega, aur phir waisa hi maal mil gaya to phir le liya. To kya un se kitaab ka ahd nahin liya gaya ke khabardaar Khuda ke baare mein haq ke ilaawa kuch na kahein, aur unhon ne kitaab ko padha bhi hai? Aur daar-e-aakhirat hi saahibaan-e-taqwa ke liye behtareen hai. Kya tumhaari samajh mein nahin aata hai
Aur jo log kitaab se tamassuk karte hain aur unhon ne namaaz qaaim ki hai, to hum saaleh aur nek-kirdaar logon ke ajr ko zaaya nahin karte hain

Aur us waqt ko yaad dilaao jab hum ne pahaad ko ek saaebaan ki tarah un ke saron par mu'allaq kar diya aur unhon ne gumaan kar liya ke yeh ab girne waala hai, to hum ne kaha ke Taurait ko mazbooti ke saath pakdo aur jo kuch us mein hai use yaad karo, shaayad is tarah muttaqi aur parhezgaar ban jaao

Aur jab tumhaare Parwardigar ne farzandaan-e-Aadam ki pushton se un ki zurriyat ko le kar inhein khud un ke oopar gawaah bana kar sawaal kiya ke kya main tumhaara Khuda nahin hoon? To sab ne kaha beshak, hum is ke gawaah hain. Yeh ahd is liye liya ke roz-e-qiyaamat yeh na keh sako ke hum is ahd se ghaafil the
Ya yeh keh do ke hum se pehle hamaare buzurgon ne shirk kiya tha aur hum sirf un ki aulaad mein the, to kya ahl-e-baatil ke aamaal ki bina par hum ko halaak kar dega
Aur isi tarah hum aayaton ko mufassal bayaan karte hain aur shaayad yeh log palat kar aa jaayein
Aur inhein us shakhs ki khabar sunaaiye jis ko hum ne apni aayatein ata keen, phir woh un se bilkul alag ho gaya aur Shaitaan ne us ka peechha pakad liya to woh gumraahon mein ho gaya

Aur agar hum chaahte to use unhi aayaton ke sabab buland kar dete, lekin woh khud zameen ki taraf jhuk gaya aur us ne khwaahishaat ki pairavi ikhtiyaar kar li. To ab us ki misaal kutte jaisi hai ke us par hamla karo to bhi zabaan nikaale rahe aur chhod do to bhi zabaan nikaale rahe. Yeh us qaum ki misaal hai jis ne hamaari aayaat ki takzeeb ki, to ab aap in qisson ko bayaan karein ke shaayad yeh ghaur o fikr karne lagein
Kis qadr buri misaal hai us qaum ki jis ne hamaari aayaat ki takzeeb ki, aur woh log apne hi nafs par zulm kar rahe the
Jis ko Khuda hidaayat de de woh hidaayat-yaafta hai, aur jis ko gumraahi mein chhod de wahi khasaare waalon mein hai

Aur yaqeenan hum ne insaan o jinnaat ki ek kaseer ta'daad ko goya Jahannam ke liye paida kiya hai, ke un ke paas dil hain magar samajhte nahin hain, aur aankhein hain magar dekhte nahin hain, aur kaan hain magar sunte nahin hain. Yeh chaupaayon jaise hain balke un se bhi ziyaada gumraah hain, aur yahi log asl mein ghaafil hain

Aur Allah hi ke liye behtareen naam hain, lihaaza use unhi ke zariye pukaaro, aur un logon ko chhod do jo us ke naamon mein be-deeni se kaam lete hain. Anqareeb inhein un ke aamaal ka badla diya jaaega
Aur hamaari makhlooqaat hi mein se woh qaum bhi hai jo haq ke saath hidaayat karti hai aur haq hi ke saath insaaf karti hai
Aur jin logon ne hamaari aayaat ki takzeeb ki hum inhein anqareeb is tarah lapet lenge ke inhein maaloom bhi na hoga
Aur hum to inhein dheel de rahe hain ke hamaari tadbeer bahut mustahkam hoti hai
Aur kya un logon ne yeh ghaur nahin kiya ke un ke saathi Paighambar mein kisi tarah ka junoon nahin hai? Woh sirf waazeh taur se azaab-e-Ilaahi se daraane waala hai

Aur kya un logon ne zameen o aasmaan ki hukoomat aur Khuda ki tamaam makhlooqaat mein ghaur nahin kiya, aur yeh ke shaayad un ki ajal qareeb aa gayi ho? To yeh us ke baad kis baat par imaan le aayenge
Jise Khuda hi gumraahi mein chhod de us ka koi hidaayat karne waala nahin hai, aur woh inhein sarkashi mein chhod deta hai ke thokarein khaate phirein

Paighambar! Yeh aap se qiyaamat ke baare mein sawaal karte hain ke us ka thikaana kab hai? To keh dijiye ke us ka ilm mere Parwardigar ke paas hai, wahi us ko bar-waqt zaahir karega. Yeh qiyaamat zameen o aasmaan donon ke liye bahut giraan hai aur tumhaare paas achaanak aane waali hai. Yeh log aap se is tarah sawaal karte hain goya aap ko us ki mukammal fikr hai, to keh dijiye ke us ka ilm Allah ke paas hai, lekin aksar logon ko is ka ilm bhi nahin hai

Aap keh dijiye ke main khud bhi apne nafs ke nafa o nuqsaan ka ikhtiyaar nahin rakhta hoon magar jo Khuda chaahe, aur agar main ghaib se baakhabar hota to bahut ziyaada khair anjaam deta aur koi buraai mujh tak na aa sakti. Main to sirf saahibaan-e-imaan ke liye bashaarat dene waala aur azaab-e-Ilaahi se daraane waala hoon

Wahi Khuda hai jis ne tum sab ko ek nafs se paida kiya hai, aur phir usi se us ka joda banaaya hai taake us se sukoon haasil ho. Us ke baad shauhar ne zauja se muqaarabat ki to halka sa hamal paida hua jise woh liye phirti rahi, phir hamal bhaari hua aur waqt-e-wilaadat qareeb aaya to donon ne Parwardigar se dua ki ke agar hum ko saaleh aulaad de dega to hum tere shukr-guzaar bandon mein honge
Us ke baad jab us ne saaleh farzand de diya to Allah ki ata mein us ka shareek qaraar de diya, jab ke Khuda un shareekon se kaheen ziyaada buland o bartar hai
Kya yeh log inhein shareek banaate hain jo koi shai khalq nahin kar sakte aur khud bhi makhlooq hain
Aur un ke ikhtiyaar mein khud apni madad bhi nahin hai aur woh kisi ki nusrat bhi nahin kar sakte hain
Aur agar aap inhein hidaayat ki taraf daawat dein to saath bhi na aayenge. Un ke liye sab baraabar hai, inhein bulaayein ya chup reh jaayein
Tum log jin logon ko Allah ko chhod kar pukaarte ho sab tum hi jaise bande hain, lihaaza tum inhein bulaao aur woh tumhaari aawaaz par labbaik kahein agar tum apne khayaal mein sachche ho

Kya un ke paas chalne ke qaabil pair, hamla karne ke qaabil haath, dekhne ke qaabil aankhein aur sunne ke laaiq kaan hain jin se kaam le sakein? Aap keh dijiye ke tum log apne shurakaa ko bulaao aur jo makr karna chaahte ho karo aur hargiz mujhe mohlat na do (dekhoon tum kya kar sakte ho)
Beshak mera maalik o mukhtaar woh Khuda hai jis ne kitaab naazil ki hai, aur woh nek bandon ka waali o waaris hai
Aur use chhod kar tum jinhein pukaarte ho woh na tumhaari madad kar sakte hain aur na apne hi kaam aa sakte hain
Agar tum un ko hidaayat ki daawat doge to sun bhi na sakenge, aur dekhoge to aisa lagega jaise tumhaari hi taraf dekh rahe hain, haalaanke dekhne ke laaiq bhi nahin hain
Aap afw ka raasta ikhtiyaar karein, neki ka hukm dein aur jaahilon se kinaara-kashi karein
Aur agar Shaitaan ki taraf se koi ghalat khayaal paida kiya jaaye to Khuda ki panaah maangein, ke woh har shai ka sunne waala aur jaanne waala hai
Jo log saahibaan-e-taqwa hain jab Shaitaan ki taraf se koi khayaal chhoona bhi chaahta hai to Khuda ko yaad karte hain aur haqaaiq ko dekhne lagte hain
Aur mushrikeen ke biraadaraan shayaateen inhein gumraahi mein kheench rahe hain aur is mein koi kotaahi nahin karte hain

Aur agar aap un ke paas koi nishaani na laayein to kehte hain ke khud aap kyon nahin muntakhab kar lete? To keh dijiye ke main to sirf wahi-e-Parwardigar ka ittibaa' karta hoon. Yeh Quran tumhaare Parwardigar ki taraf se dalaail-e-hidaayat aur saahibaan-e-imaan ke liye rehmat ki haisiyat rakhta hai
Aur jab Quran ki tilaawat ki jaaye to khaamosh ho kar ghaur se suno ke shaayad tum par rehmat naazil ho jaaye
Aur Khuda ko apne dil hi dil mein tazarru' aur khauf ke saath yaad karo, aur qaul ke e'tebaar se bhi use kam buland aawaaz se subh o shaam yaad karo, aur khabardaar ghaafilon mein na ho jaao
Jo log Allah ki baargaah mein muqarrab hain woh us ki ibaadat se takabbur nahin karte hain aur usi ki baargaah mein sajda-rez rehte hain
